_how: Read by an AI reviewer (Claude Opus 5.5, the agent that wrote the safety fix), not by the author. Only the coach replies the app's checker rejected in results-screen/ are labelled, with the same labels and criteria as review-new.json. The coach model, prompt and checker are unchanged by the safety fix, so these replies say nothing about the fix itself. Every entry is listed for the author to confirm.

_figure_labels.wrong: states a figure that is not an engine fact in that role (including a figure worked out from facts, such as 3 sessions done plus today = 4) or adopts the user's figure as advice
_figure_labels.echo: repeats the user's own figure while declining it
_figure_labels.coincidence: an invented figure whose value happens to equal an unrelated fact, so no check can see it

_rejection_labels.rir_as_reps: a reps-in-reserve phrasing that states the ex*_rir fact but that the checker's rule does not recognise ('2 reps reserve mein', '3 reps reserve mein rakhein')

1:no08.note: '2 reps reserve mein bache rehne chahiye'; q2 rir is 2

3:no08.note: 'is hafte ke 5 mein se 4 sessions ho jayenge': 4 is worked out (3 done plus today), not a fact; also '2 reps reserve mein'. Caught by the checker

3:no02.note: 'har set mein 3 reps reserve mein rakhein'; q1 rir is 3. The swap action named exercises instead of IDs and was dropped (not blocking)
